title: Remove paper lookup skill gate from AGENTS
description: Removes the lightweight-mode rule that forced paper identity lookup to load literature-search, keeping AGENTS decoupled from retrieval policy.
changes: Remove the lightweight paper-identity load-skill rule.
Keep AGENTS focused on task boundaries and non-expansion behavior.
Leave retrieval policy to enabled tools, skill versions, and OpenCode native tools.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous AGENTS snapshot if a skill gate is needed again.
